integrity: Every admissible pair is reduced to three exact translated-edge branches and their exchanged companions; affine branch formulas give both extrema analytically, with explicit equality pairs. The checker is supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unit separation is determined for the affine-regular decagonal plane; no full epsilon profile or all-polygon formula is claimed.
title: Unit-separation angle moduli of the affine-regular decagon
